_approach: An accelerating snare roll (8ths to 16ths to 32nd-implying consecutive-16th bursts, velocity 60 to 127) in the vein of Attack's '10 Snare Rolls For The Drop', but ended dariacore-style: instead of landing on the drop, the whole pattern cuts to total silence one 16th before the bar ends, matching the genre's documented taste for a hard stop/fake-out rather than a clean landing.
